selected_evidence.requirement: Shared writable directory with protection against removing files owned by other users
selected_evidence.summary: Mode 1777 was applied. Functional tests showed shared write access, successful removal of users' own files, and Operation not permitted for cross-user removal. Final state is root:root, drwxrwxrwt, and empty.

Baseline boot ID was cacc68f5-56c0-4bf9-8e54-5871f737e96c; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 4b4c34d0-7307-440c-bb81-97220bc911af. The 1777 mode and persistence proof survived, and sticky-directory behavior was revalidated after recovery.
